name: dolma-v1_7
notes: Weights are the billions of OLMo tokens OLMo 7B-v1.7 trained on per source: the 'OLMo tokens (billions)' column of the Dolma v1.7 summary table on huggingface.co/datasets/allenai/dolma, times its 'Sample Proportion'. Only their ratios matter.

The card gives one row each for Dolma's CC (1,195.5 x 50% = 597.75) and CC News (14.3 x 100%). They are split over cc_en_head/middle/tail and cc_news_head/middle/tail by the on-disk size of each folder's Lance data on flock-datasets (CC: 955.07, 1219.06, 1108.78 GB; CC News: 23.44, 10.74, 4.36 GB), an estimate.
C4 uses the card's 50% (138.4 x 50% = 69.2). The card's sampled total of 1,715.1 matches C4 at 100% instead; these rows sum to 1,645.15.
Wikipedia's 200% means two epochs in OLMo. Here it only sets the share; the compiler samples unique documents.
